text: The Curry-Howard-Lambek correspondence extends Curry-Howard by adding:
choices: Cartesian closed categories (CCCs) as a third pillar: proof ↔ term ↔ morphism
explanation: Curry-Howard-Lambek: propositions ↔ types ↔ objects; proofs ↔ terms ↔ morphisms; proof normalisation ↔ β-reduction ↔ equality of morphisms in a CCC.
